title: Untrusted Document Scope Requirement
description: Requires that external documents (PRDs, knowledge-base text) passed to an LLM are treated as data: they reach the model only as encoded fields under a system-prompt policy, and they never select the processing strategy or narrow the test scope.

scope-source.description: Where the test scope comes from: every document section as test basis, or not applicable for agents that do not derive scope.

document-encoding.description: How external document text is delimited from instructions in the model input.

untrusted-policy-in-system-prompt.description: Whether the system prompt states that the document fields are untrusted data that cannot change the task, scope or output.
